tasks.instruction: Uzupelnij zdania (1.1.-1.6.), wykorzystujac podane w nawiasach wyrazy w odpowiedniej formie. Nie zmieniaj kolejnosci podanych wyrazow, ale w razie potrzeby dodaj inne wyrazy, tak aby otrzymac logiczne i gramatycznie poprawne zdania. Wymagana jest pelna poprawnosc ortograficzna i gramatyczna.

items.context: If it _________ (not / be) for your help, I _________ (never / finish) the project on time.
The house _________ (look) after by neighbours while the family _________ (be) abroad.
Hardly _________ (the film / begin) when the power _________ (cut) off.
I would rather you _________ (not / mention) this to anyone until the deal _________ (sign).
By next summer they _________ (live) in this village for thirty years, and they still _________ (not / plan) to move.
answer: will ('ll) have been living / will ('ll) have lived

items.context: She is thought _________ (leave) the country, although nobody _________ (see) her go.
